metadata.title: Dai Nei iong | Black gram with Sesame | Khasi Recipe
metadata.description:
Dai nei iong is one of the staple dish of the Khasi people of Meghalaya. It is a black lentil (urdu dal) preparation where the black gram is soft boiled or pressure cooked and is mixed with roasted and pounded black sesame seeds and ginger-garlic paste. 

This rustic staple is commonly prepared as a side to steamed rice in the Khasi households and is pretty famous among other tribes and communities in the Northeast of India.
